ex.en: I will notify you of the arrival of the goods.
ex.zh: 貨物到了，我會通知你們。

ex.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
ex.zh: 大量生產降低了許多商品的價格。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

goods.en: things that are made to be sold

ex.en: Don't believe all the office gossip.
ex.zh: 別相信辦公室裡所有的八卦。

ex.en: She loves to hear the latest gossip.
ex.zh: 她很愛聽最新的八卦。

gossip.en: talk about other people's private lives

ex.en: The only time people dislike gossip is when you gossip about them.
ex.zh: 人們只有在你說他們閒話時，才會討厭八卦。

ex.en: They spent the whole lunch gossiping about their boss.
ex.zh: 他們整頓午餐都在聊老闆的八卦。

gossip.en: to talk about other people's private lives

ex.en: Good corporate governance builds investor trust.
ex.zh: 良好的公司治理能建立投資人的信任。

ex.en: The board is responsible for the governance of the company.
ex.zh: 董事會負責公司的治理。

governance.en: the way an organization or country is controlled

ex.en: We offered a discount as a gesture of goodwill.
ex.zh: 我們提供折扣以表達善意。

ex.en: The visit helped build goodwill between the two countries.
ex.zh: 這次訪問有助於增進兩國的友好關係。

goodwill.en: a friendly and helpful feeling toward others

ex.en: The company's goodwill is worth millions.
ex.zh: 這家公司的商譽價值數百萬。

ex.en: Poor service can damage a firm's goodwill.
ex.zh: 服務差會損害公司的商譽。

goodwill.en: the good reputation of a business, which has money value

ex.en: Non-governmental organizations play an important role in disaster relief.
ex.zh: 非政府組織在救災中扮演重要角色。

ex.en: The project needs governmental approval.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要政府核准。

governmental.en: relating to the group of people who rule a country

ex.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."
ex.zh: 「你為什麼不去？」「因為我不想去。」

ex.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
ex.zh: 我每週去健身房三次。

go.en: to move or travel to a place

ex.en: How did the interview go?
ex.zh: 面試進行得怎麼樣？

ex.en: Everything went well at the meeting.
ex.zh: 會議一切順利。

go.en: to happen or develop in a certain way

ex.en: The milk has gone bad.
ex.zh: 牛奶壞掉了。

ex.en: Something went wrong with my computer.
ex.zh: 我的電腦出了點問題。

go.en: to become something, usually something bad

ex.en: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
ex.zh: 放在保險箱裡的文件不見了。

ex.en: My headache is finally gone.
ex.zh: 我的頭痛終於好了。

go.en: to be missing or no longer there

ex.en: I'm going to visit my parents this weekend.
ex.zh: 我這週末要去看我爸媽。

ex.en: It's going to be a busy week.
ex.zh: 這週會很忙。

go.en: used to talk about what you plan or expect to do

ex.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?
ex.zh: 你好嗎？旅途愉快嗎？

ex.en: This is a good restaurant for business lunches.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳很適合商務午餐。

ex.en: She is good at solving problems.
ex.zh: 她很擅長解決問題。

ex.en: I'm not good at math.
ex.zh: 我數學不好。

ex.en: Fresh vegetables are good for your health.
ex.zh: 新鮮蔬菜對健康有益。

ex.en: Walking is good for you.
ex.zh: 走路對你有好處。

good.en: helpful to your health or situation

ex.en: Exercise will do you good.
ex.zh: 運動對你有好處。

ex.en: It's no good complaining now.
ex.zh: 現在抱怨也沒用。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: The goods will be delivered on Monday.
ex.zh: 這批貨將在星期一送達。

good.en: things that are made to be sold

ex.en: The price of gold varies from day to day.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在變動。

ex.en: The color of gold is very similar to brass.
ex.zh: 金的顏色和黃銅很像。

gold.en: a valuable yellow metal used for making jewelry

ex.en: He was given a gold watch as a reward.
ex.zh: 他獲得一支金錶作為獎勵。

ex.en: Who do you think will win the gold medal?
ex.zh: 你們覺得誰會拿到金牌？

ex.en: The diamond was set in a gold ring.
ex.zh: 鑽石鑲在一枚金戒指上。

gold.en: made of a valuable yellow metal, or having its color

ex.en: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
ex.zh: 大家都希望當初是他當選州長。

ex.en: The governor announced a new budget plan.
ex.zh: 州長宣布了新的預算計畫。

governor.en: the elected head of a state or region

ex.en: The central bank governor spoke about interest rates.
ex.zh: 央行總裁談到了利率問題。

ex.en: She sits on the school's board of governors.
ex.zh: 她是學校理事會的成員。

governor.en: a person who is in charge of an organization

ex.en: It depends what you mean by "believe" in God.
ex.zh: 這要看你所謂「相信」上帝是什麼意思。

ex.en: Many people pray to God for help.
ex.zh: 許多人向上帝祈求幫助。

god.en: the being that some religions say made the world

ex.en: In Greek mythology, Ares was the god of war.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，阿瑞斯是戰神。

ex.en: After all, even the gods may err at times.
ex.zh: 畢竟，就連神也偶爾會犯錯。

god.en: a being with special powers that people pray to

ex.en: To govern a country is not an easy job.
ex.zh: 治理一個國家不是件容易的事。

ex.en: The king governed the country.
ex.zh: 國王統治這個國家。

govern.en: to control and lead a country

ex.en: The most important feature of all games is that they are governed by rules.
ex.zh: 所有遊戲最重要的共同點，就是都受規則約束。

ex.en: Strict rules govern the use of personal data.
ex.zh: 個人資料的使用受到嚴格規範。

govern.en: to control how something works or happens

ex.en: He plays golf two or three times a month.
ex.zh: 他一個月打兩三次高爾夫球。

ex.en: Is there a golf course near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有高爾夫球場嗎？

ex.en: My mother can play golf very well.
ex.zh: 我媽媽高爾夫打得很好。

golf.en: a game in which you hit a small ball into holes with a long stick

ex.en: Her golden hair floats in the summer breeze.
ex.zh: 她一頭金髮在夏日微風中飄動。

ex.en: He received a golden watch as a prize.
ex.zh: 他獲得一支金錶作為獎品。

ex.en: The fields turned golden in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天田野變成一片金黃。

golden.en: having the color of a valuable yellow metal, or made of it

golden.zh: 寶貴的、黃金的（機會、時期）

ex.en: The Golden Age of the Romans is in the past.
ex.zh: 羅馬人的黃金時代已經過去了。

ex.en: This is a golden opportunity to expand our business.
ex.zh: 這是拓展業務的大好機會。

ex.en: The goat's milk that Mark sells is very popular among the locals.
ex.zh: 馬克賣的羊奶很受當地人歡迎。

ex.en: The farm has goats, sheep, and chickens.
ex.zh: 農場裡有山羊、綿羊和雞。

ex.en: We bought some goat cheese at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些羊乳酪。

goat.en: an animal with horns that lives on farms and hills

ex.en: She did it out of the goodness of her heart.
ex.zh: 她是出於一片好心才這麼做的。

ex.en: I believe in the goodness of people.
ex.zh: 我相信人性本善。

goodness.en: the quality of being kind and good

ex.en: My goodness, look at the time!
ex.zh: 天啊，看看都幾點了！

ex.en: Goodness, you've grown so tall!
ex.zh: 天哪，你長得好高了！

ex.en: Thank goodness you're safe.
ex.zh: 謝天謝地，你平安無事。

ex.en: Thank goodness it's Friday.
ex.zh: 謝天謝地，終於星期五了。

goodness.en: used to show you are happy that something bad did not happen

ex.en: Are humans like goldfish in a fishbowl?
ex.zh: 人類是不是就像魚缸裡的金魚？

ex.en: My daughter has two goldfish in a small tank.
ex.zh: 我女兒在小魚缸裡養了兩隻金魚。

goldfish.en: a small orange fish kept as a pet

goldfish.zh: memory like a goldfish：記性很差

ex.en: I have a memory like a goldfish.
ex.zh: 我的記性跟金魚一樣差。

ex.en: I have the memory of a goldfish.
ex.zh: 我的記憶力跟金魚差不多。

goldfish.en: used to say that someone forgets things very quickly

ex.en: Goodbye! When you have more time, come back and play!
ex.zh: 再見！有空再來玩！

ex.en: Goodbye, everyone! See you next week.
ex.zh: 大家再見！下週見。

ex.en: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.
ex.zh: 他甚至沒說再見就離開了家。

ex.en: As the train pulled out, they waved goodbye to their parents.
ex.zh: 火車開出的時候，他們都揮手向父母道別。

ex.en: Goodbyes are always sad.
ex.zh: 道別總是令人難過。

goodbye.en: the words or act of saying you are leaving

ex.en: Pachamama is a goddess of earth and fertility revered by the indigenous peoples of the Andes.
ex.zh: 帕查瑪瑪是安地斯山脈土著居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。

ex.en: In Greek myths, Athena is the goddess of wisdom.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，雅典娜是智慧女神。

ex.en: Fans called the singer a goddess after her amazing concert.
ex.zh: 那場精彩的演唱會後，粉絲都稱這位歌手為女神。

goddess.en: a female being with special powers that people pray to

ex.en: Few governments can manage the economy successfully.
ex.zh: 能把經濟管好的政府很少。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 政府明確表示打算減稅。

government.en: the group of people who control a country

ex.en: The gourmet praised the chef"s use of regional ingredients.
ex.zh: 這位美食家稱讚主廚善用地方食材。

ex.en: A gourmet reviewed the new tasting menu for the magazine.
ex.zh: 一位美食家為雜誌評論了新推出的品嚐菜單。

gourmet.en: a person who knows a lot about good food and drink

ex.en: My goal in life is to be a novelist.
ex.zh: 我的人生目標是成為小說家。

ex.en: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
ex.zh: 你們打算怎麼達成你們設定的目標？

ex.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
ex.zh: 我下定決心要在三年之內達成目標。

ex.zh: 最後一分鐘，馬塞洛踢進一球，把比分扳平。

ex.en: He scored two goals in the first half.
ex.zh: 他上半場進了兩球。

goal.en: a point scored in a game, or the space the ball must enter

ex.en: The going rate for a haircut here is about three hundred dollars.
ex.zh: 這裡剪頭髮的現行行情大約是三百元。

ex.en: Is the project still going smoothly?
ex.zh: 這個專案還進行得順利嗎？

ex.en: His going left the whole team feeling sad.
ex.zh: 他的離去讓整個團隊都很難過。

ex.en: The going was slow because of the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 因為下大雨，行進的速度很慢。

gospel.zh: 福音（基督教聖經中的福音書）

ex.en: The pastor read a passage from the gospel on Sunday.
ex.zh: 牧師在週日朗讀了一段福音書的內容。

ex.en: There are four gospels in the New Testament.
ex.zh: 新約聖經裡有四本福音書。

gospel.zh: 絕對真理、深信不疑的事

ex.en: Don't take everything online as gospel truth.
ex.zh: 別把網路上的一切都當成絕對真理。

ex.en: He treats his boss's words as gospel.
ex.zh: 他把老闆說的話當成金科玉律。

ex.en: Mikhail Gorbachev was the last leader of the Soviet Union.
ex.zh: 米哈伊爾·戈巴契夫是蘇聯的最後一任領導人。

ex.en: We learned about Gorbachev in our modern history class.
ex.zh: 我們在現代史課上學到了戈巴契夫。

ex.en: The city has a beautiful Gothic cathedral with tall towers.
ex.zh: 這座城市有一座擁有高塔的美麗哥德式大教堂。

ex.en: Gothic windows are tall and pointed at the top.
ex.zh: 哥德式的窗戶高而尖頂。

ex.en: The architect was famous for his use of Gothic in churches.
ex.zh: 那位建築師以在教堂中運用哥德風格聞名。

ex.en: Some people love the dark mood of Gothic in novels.
ex.zh: 有些人喜歡小說中哥德風格的陰暗氛圍。

ex.en: She wore a long red gown to the dance.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件紅色長禮服去參加舞會。

ex.en: The bride's wedding gown was made of white silk.
ex.zh: 新娘的婚紗是用白色絲綢做成的。

ex.en: The nurse helped him change into a hospital gown.
ex.zh: 護理師幫他換上病人服。

ex.en: Students wore a black gown at the graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 學生在畢業典禮上穿著黑色學位袍。

ex.en: You look gorgeous in that dress!
ex.zh: 你穿那件洋裝美極了！

ex.en: The view from the hotel balcony was gorgeous.
ex.zh: 從飯店陽台看出去的景色美得令人讚嘆。

ex.en: It was a gorgeous day, so we had lunch outside.
ex.zh: 那天天氣好極了，所以我們在戶外吃午餐。

ex.en: We had gorgeous weather for the whole holiday.
ex.zh: 整個假期的天氣都好得不得了。

ex.en: A goose walked slowly across the grass beside the lake.
ex.zh: 一隻鵝在湖邊的草地上慢慢走過。

ex.en: We had roast goose for dinner on the holiday.
ex.zh: 假日的晚餐我們吃了烤鵝。

ex.en: Don't be a silly goose, of course I'm not angry with you.
ex.zh: 別傻了，我當然沒有在生你的氣。

ex.en: She laughed and called her little brother a silly goose.
ex.zh: 她笑著叫弟弟是個小傻瓜。

governing.zh: 治理、統治（govern 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The party has been governing the country for ten years.
ex.zh: 這個政黨已經執政這個國家十年了。

ex.en: Who is governing the city while the mayor is away?
ex.zh: 市長不在時，是誰在管理這座城市？

ex.en: The governing party lost several seats in the election.
ex.zh: 執政黨在選舉中失去了幾個席次。

ex.en: The school's governing board meets once a month.
ex.zh: 學校的管理委員會每月開會一次。

ex.en: The goalkeeper jumped and saved the penalty kick.
ex.zh: 守門員撲出去，擋下了這記十二碼罰球。

ex.en: Our goalkeeper is the tallest player on the team.
ex.zh: 我們的守門員是球隊裡最高的球員。

ex.en: My uncle is a keen golfer and plays every weekend.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是個熱衷的高爾夫球手，每個週末都打球。

ex.en: The golfer hit the ball straight down the fairway.
ex.zh: 那位球員把球直直打向球道。

ex.en: Gosh, I forgot my keys again!
ex.zh: 天啊，我又忘了帶鑰匙！

ex.en: Oh gosh, is it already midnight?
ex.zh: 哎呀，已經半夜了嗎？

ex.en: The goldsmith made a delicate ring by hand.
ex.zh: 金匠手工打造了一枚精巧的戒指。

ex.en: Her grandfather worked as a goldsmith for forty years.
ex.zh: 她的祖父當了四十年的金匠。

ex.en: Goodnight, sleep well and see you tomorrow!
ex.zh: 晚安，好好睡，明天見！

ex.en: She smiled and said goodnight to everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 她微笑著向派對上的每個人道晚安。

ex.en: The baby gorilla clung to its mother at the zoo.
ex.zh: 小猩猩在動物園裡緊緊抱著牠的媽媽。

ex.en: A gorilla can be very gentle even though it is huge.
ex.zh: 大猩猩雖然體型龐大，卻可以很溫和。

ex.en: In the fairy tale, a goblin hides gold under the mountain.
ex.zh: 在童話故事裡，有個小妖精把黃金藏在山底下。

ex.en: The children dressed up as a goblin for the school play.
ex.zh: 孩子們在學校的戲劇裡打扮成小妖精。

ex.en: A river runs through the deep gorge.
ex.zh: 一條河流過深深的峽谷。

ex.en: The hikers walked along the edge of the gorge.
ex.zh: 登山客沿著峽谷邊緣行走。

ex.en: The kids gorged themselves on cake at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子們在派對上狼吞虎嚥地吃蛋糕。

ex.en: After the long hike, we gorged on hot noodles.
ex.zh: 長途健行後，我們大口吃著熱騰騰的麵。

ex.en: The kids gobbled up their dinner in five minutes.
ex.zh: 孩子們五分鐘就把晚餐狼吞虎嚥吃完了。

ex.en: Don't gobble your food, or you'll get a stomachache.
ex.zh: 別狼吞虎嚥，不然你會肚子痛。

ex.en: We heard the gobble of a turkey on the farm.
ex.zh: 我們在農場聽到火雞的咯咯叫聲。

ex.en: The turkey let out a loud gobble at dawn.
ex.zh: 火雞在黎明發出響亮的咯咯聲。

ex.en: He put on his swimming goggles before jumping into the pool.
ex.zh: 他在跳進游泳池前戴上了蛙鏡。

ex.en: Safety goggles protect your eyes in the science lab.
ex.zh: 安全護目鏡能在實驗室裡保護你的眼睛。

ex.en: The children goggled at the huge cake.
ex.zh: 孩子們瞪大眼睛看著那個巨大的蛋糕。

ex.en: Don't just goggle at the screen all day.
ex.zh: 別整天只是瞪著螢幕看。

ex.en: Grandma brought a bag of goodies for the kids.
ex.zh: 奶奶帶了一袋好吃的東西給孩子們。

ex.en: The gift box was full of goodies from around the world.
ex.zh: 那個禮盒裡裝滿來自世界各地的好東西。

ex.en: Golfing is a popular weekend activity for my dad.
ex.zh: 打高爾夫球是我爸爸受歡迎的週末活動。

ex.en: We planned a golfing trip to the coast.
ex.zh: 我們計劃了一趟去海邊的高爾夫之旅。

ex.en: They are golfing at the new course today.
ex.zh: 他們今天正在新球場打高爾夫球。

ex.en: He met his boss while golfing on Sunday.
ex.zh: 他週日打高爾夫球時遇到了老闆。

ex.en: He made a goofy face to cheer up the baby.
ex.zh: 他扮了個鬼臉逗嬰兒開心。

ex.en: My dog looks goofy when it wears a hat.
ex.zh: 我的狗戴帽子時看起來傻傻的。

gogh.zh: 梵谷（荷蘭畫家 Van Gogh 的姓）

ex.en: Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch painter.
ex.zh: 文森·梵谷是荷蘭畫家。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of van Gogh's paintings.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了大量梵谷的畫作。

ex.en: The knife slipped and gouged a deep line in the table.
ex.zh: 刀子滑了一下，在桌上刻出一道深痕。

ex.en: The tires gouged ruts in the soft ground.
ex.zh: 輪胎在鬆軟的地面壓出深深的車轍。

ex.en: Some shops gouge tourists by doubling the price.
ex.zh: 有些商店會把價格加倍來坑觀光客。

ex.en: Gas stations were accused of gouging drivers during the storm.
ex.zh: 加油站被指控在暴風雨期間趁機坑駕駛人。

ex.en: The kids got a bag of goodies at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子們在派對上拿到一袋好吃的小零食。

ex.en: Grandma packed some goodies for our trip.
ex.zh: 奶奶為我們的旅行準備了一些好吃的點心。

ex.en: Goody, we're having pizza tonight!
ex.zh: 太棒了，今晚吃披薩！

ex.en: Oh goody, the weekend is finally here.
ex.zh: 哇，太好了，週末終於到了。

ex.en: He asked his uncle to be the baby's godfather.
ex.zh: 他請叔叔當寶寶的教父。

ex.en: My godfather gave me a watch on my birthday.
ex.zh: 我的教父在我生日時送了我一只手錶。

ex.en: The goalie dived to stop the shot.
ex.zh: 守門員撲身擋下了那一球。

ex.en: Our goalie is only fifteen years old.
ex.zh: 我們的守門員才十五歲。

ex.en: The old man carried water in a dried gourd.
ex.zh: 老人用一個乾葫蘆裝水帶著走。

ex.en: She grew a large gourd in her garden this summer.
ex.zh: 她今年夏天在花園裡種了一顆大葫蘆。

gondola.zh: 貢多拉（威尼斯平底小船）

ex.en: We rode a gondola along the canals of Venice.
ex.zh: 我們坐貢多拉遊覽了威尼斯的運河。

ex.en: The gondola glided quietly under the old stone bridge.
ex.zh: 貢多拉安靜地滑過古老的石橋底下。

ex.en: The ski gondola carried us up to the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 滑雪纜車載我們上到山頂。

ex.en: Six people can fit in one gondola.
ex.zh: 一節纜車車廂可以坐六個人。

ex.en: My godmother gave me a book on my birthday.
ex.zh: 我的教母在我生日時送了我一本書。

ex.en: She asked her friend to be the baby's godmother.
ex.zh: 她請朋友當寶寶的教母。

ex.en: His friends goaded him into jumping off the dock.
ex.zh: 朋友們慫恿他從碼頭跳下去。

ex.en: She was goaded by the criticism to work even harder.
ex.zh: 那些批評激得她更加努力。

ex.en: The farmer used a goad to move the cattle.
ex.zh: 農夫用趕牛棒驅趕牛群。

ex.en: Fear of failure was a goad that kept him studying.
ex.zh: 害怕失敗是促使他不斷讀書的動力。

ex.en: He raised his goblet and made a toast to the bride.
ex.zh: 他舉起高腳杯向新娘敬酒。

ex.en: A silver goblet stood on the table beside the candles.
ex.zh: 一只銀製高腳杯放在蠟燭旁的桌上。

ex.en: Some viewers dislike the gore in horror movies.
ex.zh: 有些觀眾不喜歡恐怖片裡血淋淋的畫面。

ex.en: The film was criticized for too much gore.
ex.zh: 這部電影因血腥場面過多而受到批評。

ex.en: The family hired a governess to teach the children at home.
ex.zh: 這個家庭請了一位女家教在家教孩子們。

ex.en: In the novel, a young governess arrives at a big old house.
ex.zh: 在小說裡，一位年輕的女家教來到一棟老舊的大宅。

ex.en: A wild gobbler strutted across the field.
ex.zh: 一隻野生的公火雞在田野上昂首闊步。

ex.en: Hunters listen for the call of a gobbler in the spring.
ex.zh: 獵人在春天會留意公火雞的叫聲。

ex.en: There was sticky goo all over the kitchen counter.
ex.zh: 廚房流理臺上到處是黏黏的東西。

ex.en: The kids played with green goo at the science fair.
ex.zh: 孩子們在科學展上玩綠色的黏液。

ex.en: Gonorrhoea is an infection that can be treated with antibiotics.
ex.zh: 淋病是一種可以用抗生素治療的感染。

ex.en: Health classes teach students how to prevent diseases like gonorrhoea.
ex.zh: 健康教育課教學生如何預防像淋病這樣的疾病。

ex.en: Don't be such a goof; just try it.
ex.zh: 別這麼傻了，試試看吧。

ex.en: He is a lovable goof who always makes us laugh.
ex.zh: 他是個討人喜歡的傻大個，總是逗我們笑。

ex.en: I goofed and sent the email to the wrong person.
ex.zh: 我搞砸了，把郵件寄給錯的人。

ex.en: Try not to goof up the order this time.
ex.zh: 這次別再把訂單搞砸了。

ex.en: He grew a goatee to look older.
ex.zh: 他留了山羊鬍讓自己看起來更成熟。

ex.en: The man with the gray goatee smiled at us.
ex.zh: 那位留著灰色山羊鬍的男士對我們微笑。

ex.en: A loud gong signaled the start of the ceremony.
ex.zh: 一聲響亮的鑼聲宣告典禮開始。

ex.en: The monk struck the gong three times.
ex.zh: 僧人敲了三下鑼。

ex.en: The shop owner hired a couple of goons to scare people.
ex.zh: 店主雇了幾個打手去嚇唬人。

ex.en: The movie's villain always sends his goons to do the dirty work.
ex.zh: 電影裡的反派總是派手下去幹髒活。

ex.en: Stop acting like a goon and listen to me.
ex.zh: 別再像個傻瓜一樣胡鬧，聽我說。

ex.en: My brother is such a goon when he tries to dance.
ex.zh: 我弟弟一跳舞就像個大傻瓜。

ex.en: I don't like gory horror movies.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡血腥的恐怖片。

ex.en: The report gave gory details of the accident.
ex.zh: 報導描述了意外現場血淋淋的細節。

ex.en: The gooey chocolate cake melted in my mouth.
ex.zh: 黏稠的巧克力蛋糕在我嘴裡化開。

ex.en: My hands got gooey from the melted candy.
ex.zh: 融化的糖果弄得我雙手黏答答的。

governorship.zh: 州長（或總督）的職位或任期

ex.en: He ran for the governorship of his home state.
ex.zh: 他參選了家鄉那個州的州長職位。

ex.en: During her governorship, the state built several new bridges.
ex.zh: 在她擔任州長期間，該州蓋了好幾座新橋。

ex.en: The extra money was a godsend for the family.
ex.zh: 這筆額外的錢對這個家庭來說是及時雨。

ex.en: The rain was a godsend after the long drought.
ex.zh: 久旱之後，這場雨真是天賜之福。
